description:
"Summon an ancient portal, which arms after |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

When triggered the enemy is teleported to you if within range, immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds, and dealt |cffffff6257|r Frost Damage.

An ally in the portal can activate the Icy Escape synergy, teleporting them to you and granting them Major Expedition, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff8|r seconds.

You can have up to |cffffff3|r Frozen Retreats active at a time."
